site.home: Charta, back to the home page
site.footerTagline: Brand guidelines composed from a logo, measured by engines and adjustable page by page.

homePage.metaTitle: Charta · A complete brand guideline from your logo

hero.title: Your logo becomes a complete guideline.
hero.lead: Drop the file: Charta measures its colours, checks every contrast, and composes the pages and mockups. Then you edit each page by hand or by talking to the copilot.
hero.note: No credit card. Your logo is never redrawn.

atelier.title: The studio, with a real guideline
atelier.lead: A sample brand composed by the same engines as yours. Switch pages, read the measurements.

drop.title: Drop
drop.text: SVG, PNG, WebP or JPEG. The file is checked and sanitised before it is read, the original stays private.

watch.title: Watch
watch.text: The analysis runs live: logo reading, palette and contrast, typography, assembly. Pages land on the table as they are ready.

adjust.title: Adjust
adjust.text: A colour, a font, a format, or one sentence to the copilot. Every change is a command you can undo.

promise.logo: The logo is never redrawn by an AI.
promise.measured: Every value shown is computed, with its source.
promise.undo: Every change can be undone and redone.
promise.export: PDF export, logo files and CSS tokens.

final.title: Drop your logo.
final.lead: The first guideline takes a few minutes, no account needed.

pricing.title: Free to start, paid plans to come.
pricing.lead: Start free with three projects. Paid plans arrive after the beta.
pricing.hypothesis: Indicative prices, not billed for now: no payment is possible.

free.name: Free
free.audience: To try it and for a first client.

feature.unlimited: As many projects as you need

pricing.a1: An SVG logo (5 MB at most), PNG, WebP or JPEG (10 MB and 8192 × 8192 px at most). The file is checked before it is read.
pricing.q2: Do my files belong to me?
pricing.a2: You keep your rights on your logos. The terms on generated texts and layouts will be set out in the terms of use, worded with care.
pricing.q3: What does the PDF export contain?
pricing.a3: Every page of the guideline, with texts and logos as vectors. It is a reference PDF in RGB: it is not presented as print-ready.
pricing.a4: It is sanitised, stays private and can only be read from your project. It is never redrawn by an AI: variants and mockups are computed from your file.
